title: Tips on making a character creator tool for a 3D game
author: PositiveScarcity8909
selftext:
I decided against all reason that having a simple character customization panel in my game was a good idea.

For this I downloaded a few asset packs but none of them seem to fit my game or look rather ugly in general.

My other option is to create a bunch of models using Tripo and then cut and swap things around for customization, but this sounds like a nightmare, everything is gonna end not fitting with each other and I'm gonna burn through all my tokens.

So before doing all that I thought it would be wise to ask here for expert advice.

comments.author: SlightOfHand_
comments.body:
Honestly this seems to be unclaimed territory, no one has a good solution out of the box. There are generators but they are inconsistent in style and size; some advertise automatically breaking the model into parts but that is also too inconsistent to rely on. So there’s no one good automated flow. Once you have something that halfway works for you, there are workflows through comfyai that can automate whatever you’ve janked together, but in any case it appears you probably have a lot of work ahead of you to achieve this.

I would particularly avoid the subscription services, in my experiments they tend to overpromise and underdeliver.
